_comment: Registry of known open IC-design benchmarks. Drives /vibe-ic-benchmark. Each entry maps a benchmark to its canonical run-shape (per open-benchmark-methodology skill § 2 + § 5 cheat sheet) + the on-disk layout + the dataset source.

rtllm.title: RTLLM v2.0 (spec-to-RTL, standalone designs)
rtllm.scorer_substitution_gap_note: Per open-benchmark-methodology § 3-§ 4 + § 4.1 floor-proof. v0.1.44 flagged asyn_fifo as scorer_substitution_recovered_fail on the belief that a specific CANDIDATE asyn_fifo RTL had a real functional bug. v1.3.43 re-ran the § 4.1 floor-proof on the GOLDEN (verified_asyn_fifo.v renamed to asyn_fifo, official testbench.v + tri_gen/wfull/rempty reference vectors) and CORRECTED the record: the golden compiles+PASSES ('===Your Design Passed===') under BOTH Verilator 5.020 --timing (10/10 stable, DISCRIMINATING — a wfull-forced-0 mutant reports Error) AND the forked iverilog 14.0-devel in vibeic-eda:0.2.5. It FAILS only under stock iverilog 12 (the official TB uses `break;` at line 102, an SV feature iverilog 12 rejects). So asyn_fifo is a GENUINE tool-substitution gap that RECOVERS — same class as ring_counter — NOT a candidate-RTL bug. It is FORK-FIXABLE and already fork-fixed (tools/vibeic-eda/FIX_STATUS.md, Tool 5 iverilog `break;`/`continue;` 🟢 upstream-adopted). scorer_substitution_gap stays [] (parallel to ring_counter, which is also recovered yet not excused) — this is a record correction, no pass-rate/denominator change. Honest scoring per § 3.
rtllm.status: RUNNABLE — standalone designs with own testbench, Shape B harness

pyhdl-eval.title: PyHDL-Eval (168 spec-to-RTL across HDLs)
pyhdl-eval.blocker: Golden RefModule .v solutions DELIBERATELY REMOVED from public repo (README confirms: anti-training-contamination). Per-problem _test.v compares DUT vs RefModule; without the 168 RefModule golden files it cannot elaborate. Same gated-oracle situation as CVDP full. Document and skip; do NOT publish a number.

rtl-repo.title: RTL-Repo (next-line autocompletion)
rtl-repo.blocker: Metric is Edit-Similarity + Exact-Match string similarity to upstream verbatim — NOT functional spec-to-RTL generation. Anti-correlated with correct-by-construction generation: a clean module that differs textually from the upstream line scores low even when functionally correct. We ship score_rtlrepo.py so users who must publish an RTL-Repo number CAN do so honestly, but the score does NOT measure what Vibe-IC optimizes for. Do NOT use this as a Vibe-IC capability number.
rtl-repo.status: OUT-OF-SCOPE-METRIC — scorer shipped for completeness, but the metric does not measure Vibe-IC's value

metrex.title: MetRex (post-synthesis metric reasoning)
metrex.blocker: Task is post-synthesis METRIC REASONING (predict area/delay/power from a netlist), not RTL generation. Different shape from Vibe-IC's spec→silicon flow. Could be pursued as a separate reasoning benchmark but is out of scope for the doc→GDS measurement.

resbench.title: ResBench (FPGA resource-aware generation)
resbench.blocker: FPGA-resource-targeted (LUT/FF/DSP utilization). Requires the full FPGA synth flow (Quartus/Vivado). Vibe-IC has eda_fpga_compile but the resource-metric harness isn't bundled. Doable but deferred until FPGA-resource-harness lands.

chipagentsbench.title: ChipAgentsBench (agentic design + verification)
chipagentsbench.blocker: Not yet public (IEEE-EDPS 2025 paper; open subset announced). Re-evaluate when the subset releases.

cvdp-full.title: CVDP full set (1,500+ problems, 13 categories)
cvdp-full.blocker: Historical: pre-v1.1.0 the full set was gated. Now see cvdp-open for the 749-problem open release.
cvdp-full.status: SUPERSEDED by cvdp-open — the HF v1.1.0 open release makes 749 problems runnable today; the remaining gated problems stay NVIDIA/Turing-only

benchmark_clean.status: RUNNABLE — full runner + benchmark-verify skill (six pillars)

flow.nonagentic: CANONICAL (RULE 0 / § 5.1, owner directive 2026-07-05): cvdp_task_router.py (routes each record by its cidNNN) -> route=phase1_entry: cvdp_phase1_entry.py -> vibe_ic_one_shot_runner.py (json-to-rtl deterministic, WAIVE to spec-to-rtl AI-backup) ; route=ai_led: the per-cid plugin loop (cvdp_context_interface_recover + modify_complete_synth / debug_first_pass -> rtl-repair / rtl-review) -> cvdp_gate.py --prompts <prompts.jsonl> --dataset <dataset.jsonl> (SOLE EMIT PATH; BOTH flags are REQUIRED - without them the #559 module-name, #715/#734 multi-file and #729 area guards are inactive and the gate now REFUSES) -> official run_benchmark.py
flow.nonagentic_legacy_DO_NOT_USE: SUPERSEDED — local_export -> blind authoring -> cvdp_gate.py -> local_import. This skips Phase-1 entirely and lets an AI author RTL free-hand, which measures 'a frontier model + cvdp_gate', NOT the Vibe-IC runner (§ 5.1). RULE 0 forbids it as a bespoke benchmark-only harness. Every published CVDP number to date came from this path; a number from it must be labelled blind-author, never a product number.

cvdp-open.scorer: official run_benchmark.py with OSS_SIM_IMAGE built from the upstream Dockerfile.sim — run eda_image_preflight.py FIRST (#536: image must match iverilog 13 / yosys 0.40 / cocotb 2.0.1 / verilator 5.038 or scoring is refused); no tool substitution needed (image is fully OSS since v1.1.0)
cvdp-open.triage: verify_fail_triage.py (#534) classifies fails into SYNTH_GATE/ELAB_ERROR/FUNC_PARTIAL/FUNC_ALL with blind-safe hints
cvdp-open.status: RUNNABLE. Best BLIND-AUTHOR number 243/302 = 80.46% (v1.2.63, 5-tier: T1 38/38 deterministic-emit, T2 176/221 program-extracted-spec + AI). A CANONICAL Phase-1-entry number is a TARGET RE-RUN and does NOT exist yet (§ 5.1). Cautionary datapoint 2026-08-24: a hand-rolled prompt->drafts->gate loop with the gate's guard flags omitted scored 192/302 = 63.58% — no deterministic emit, no program-extracted spec, 0/5 on multi-file, and every area claim unchecked.

solve_entry.ai_led_route: per-cid plugin loop, see open-benchmark-methodology § 5.1 table
solve_entry.tier_measure: programs/cvdp_solve_pipeline.py --dist  (5-TIER; T1 = deterministic emit, no AI)
solve_entry.note: --prompts AND --dataset are not optional conveniences; they arm the guards. The gate refuses without them (or an explicit --without-spec-guards).
